 At Jabalpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Shri Kush Singh - Advocate for the appellant.
Shri Rajeev Pandey - Panel Lawyer for the respondent/State.

Order 
This criminal appeal has been filed under Section 14-A of the SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act,
1989.

2. Appellant has been arrested in connection with Crime No.56/2025 registered at Police Station-Gadwa, District - Singrouli for the offences punishable under Sections 366, 450, 376(2)(N)
and 370 of IPC and Section 3(2)(v), 3(2)(va) and 3(1)(w)(ii) of SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act.
Appellant is in jail since 18.03.2025.
3. Prosecution story, in brief, is that appellant took away prosecutrix and thereafter sold her to co-appellant Sonu Jat for Rs. 1,02,000/-.
4. Learned counsel for the appellant submits that in the instant case, prosecutrix has been examined.
She has turned hostile and she did not support the prosecution story.
It is alleged that co-appellant has been released on bail.
It is also urged that prosecutrix has filed an affidavit before the trial Court to the effect that she has no objection, if appellant is released on bail.
Appellant is in jail since. 18.03.2025..
The trial of the case will take considerable time.
Therefore, it has NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:30558 2 CRA-5453-2025 been prayed that the appellant be released on bail pending the trial.

sentences.text: On the other hand, learned counsel for the State has opposed grant of bail.
6. In view of over all facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on the merit of the case, I am inclined to release the appellant on bail.
Consequently, this appeal stands allowed.

7. It is directed that appellant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.15,000/- (Rupees Fifteen Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.
He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 480(3) of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
8. This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
9. Soft copy of this bail order be sent immediately/forthwith to appellant through concerned jail Superintendent 10.
Certified copy as per rules.

(ACHAL KUMAR PALIWAL) JUDGE L.R.
